mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PWD, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, MEMBER_IMG, ROLE, CREATE_DATE, DEL_YN, MEMBER_IMG_PATH FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_PWD, MEMBER_NAME, PHONE, EMAIL ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberPwd}, #{memberName}, #{phone}, #{email} )
